title: Design System: Portfolio Heber Daza — PCB Circuit Board

display.purpose: Hero name. Extreme size, tight tracking, extra-bold. The largest type on the page — used only for the developer's full name in the U1 processor section.

display-mono.purpose: Reserved monospace display size. Large code-style headings. Currently reserved for future use.

designator.purpose: PCB component labels (U1, M1, IC3, etc.) — mono, uppercase, tight tracking. Always appears alongside or above section headings to identify the circuit component.

silkscreen.purpose: Technical micro-labels used for spec references (PROGRAMMING_LANG, BACKEND_STACK), pin counts, period labels, and secondary metadata printed as if on the board silkscreen.

body.purpose: Running paragraph text in Exo 2. Ranges from 0.875rem to 1.125rem. Light weight (300) for intro paragraphs, regular (400) for standard body. Max line length ~65ch via container constraints.

headline.purpose: Section titles at 1.875rem (mobile) to 2.25rem (desktop). Bold (700), tight tracking. Uses Exo 2. Always preceded by a component designator label.

shadows.name: component-default
shadows.purpose: Chip body containers at rest. Deep offset shadow lifts the chip off the board, while the 1px trace-colored ring defines the component edge.

shadows.name: component-hover
shadows.purpose: Chip body interactive hover. Deeper offset adds elevation, brighter ring suggests signal activity, and the trace glow implies the component is powered.

shadows.name: trace-glow
shadows.purpose: Ambient glow behind active trace elements (primary CTA buttons, active pads). Cyan emission that suggests current flowing through the trace.

shadows.name: pad-default
shadows.purpose: Gold contact pad at rest. A subtle 2px bottom offset creates the impression of a raised gold pad on the board surface.

shadows.name: pad-hover
shadows.purpose: Gold contact pad interactive hover. Outer glow radiates from the pad, and the bottom offset intensifies. Used on social icon buttons and secondary CTAs.

shadows.name: trace-ring
shadows.purpose: Subtle 1px trace-colored ring for non-interactive trace-path demarcation.

shadows.name: text-trace-glow
shadows.purpose: Text-level glow for highlighted trace text. Applied via text-shadow to the name highlight span in Hero.

shadows.name: text-copper-glow
shadows.purpose: Text-level glow for highlighted copper/gold text. Available as a utility class for accent text emphasis.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, color changes). Tailwind default ease-out. Used on all interactive elements.

motion.name: signal-pulse
motion.purpose: Scroll indicator (ChevronDown) and via dots pulse. Opacity oscillates 0.4 to 1. Invites the visitor to scroll down and indicates active signal path nodes.

motion.name: led-blink
motion.purpose: Status LED indicators throughout the board. Opacity oscillates 1 to 0.3. Marks SYSTEM ACTIVE, ONLINE, and other live statuses.

motion.name: trace-dash
motion.purpose: Reserved for SVG trace animations. Stroke dash offset animation that creates the illusion of current flowing along a copper trace.

motion.name: power-on
motion.purpose: Reserved section entrance animation. Fade in from 0 opacity with brightness ramp 0.3 to 1. Simulates a board powering up.

motion.name: scan-line
motion.purpose: Reserved decorative overlay. Vertical translate from -100% to 100vh, creating a CRT-style scan line effect.

components.name: Primary Button (Trace Signal)
components.description: Primary CTA — cyan trace border, mono label in snake_case (ver_proyectos, ver_certificados). Represents an active signal route on the board. Hover intensifies the trace glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-trace { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: rgba(0,200,200,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,200,0.3); color: #00e5ff; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-radius: 0.125rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-trace:hover { background: rgba(0,200,200,0.15); border-color: rgba(0,200,200,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,229,255,0.15); } .ds-btn-trace:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00e5ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-trace__prompt { color: #008888; }

components.name: Secondary Button (Copper Pad)
components.description: Secondary CTA — gold copper border, lowercase label (contactar). Represents a gold contact pad on the PCB. Hover triggers pad glow effect.
components.css: .ds-btn-copper { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(196,164,74,0.3); color: #c4a44a; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-radius: 0.125rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-copper:hover { background: rgba(196,164,74,0.05); border-color: rgba(196,164,74,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(212,168,67,0.3), 0 2px 0 rgba(180,140,60,0.6); } .ds-btn-copper:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c4a44a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-copper__prompt { color: #8a7234; }

components.name: Submit Button (Transmit)
components.description: Form submission button — full width, trace border, Send icon, UPPERCASE label (TRANSMITIR, ENVIAR). Represents a signal transmission action.

components.css: .ds-btn-transmit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: rgba(0,200,200,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,200,0.3); color: #00e5ff; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-radius: 0.125rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-transmit:hover { background: rgba(0,200,200,0.15); border-color: rgba(0,200,200,0.5); } .ds-btn-transmit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00e5ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-transmit:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-transmit__icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Chip Body (Card Container)
components.description: The universal container for PCB components — skills modules, project cards, about spec chips, education panels. Raised off the substrate with component shadow and silver via-ring border.

components.css: .ds-chip-body { background: #0e120e; border: 1px solid rgba(106,114,128,0.3); border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,200,200,0.08); transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-chip-body:hover { border-color: rgba(0,200,200,0.3); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,200,200,0.2), 0 0 24px rgba(0,229,255,0.08); } .ds-chip-body__designator { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #c4a44a; } .ds-chip-body__title { font-family: 'Exo 2', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #d8dcd6; margin-top: 0.25rem; } .ds-chip-body__text { font-family: 'Exo 2', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: #8a9088; margin-top: 0.5rem; }

components.name: Input Field (Contact Form)
components.description: Text input for contact form — dark substrate background, silver via-ring border, mono font. Labels are UPPERCASE micro-text with 0.2em tracking. Focus shifts border to trace cyan.
components.css: .ds-input-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-input-group__label { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #8a9088; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: #080c08; border: 1px solid rgba(106,114,128,0.3); border-radius: 0.125rem; color: #d8dcd6; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(138,144,136,0.5); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(0,200,200,0.5); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00e5ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Textarea Field
components.description: Multiline text input variant — same styling as the text input but with resize disabled and a taller default height. Labeled PAYLOAD in the contact form.
components.css: .ds-input-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; } .ds-input-group__label { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #8a9088; margin-bottom: 0.375rem; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-textarea { width: 100%; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; background: #080c08; border: 1px solid rgba(106,114,128,0.3); border-radius: 0.125rem; color: #d8dcd6; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; resize: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: rgba(138,144,136,0.5); } .ds-textarea:focus { border-color: rgba(0,200,200,0.5); outline: none; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00e5ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link (Header Item)
components.description: Desktop navigation link — mono micro-text, dim silkscreen color, trace underline on hover that scales from left. Represents a silkscreen-printed routing label on the board edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #8a9088; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; height: 1px; background: rgba(0,200,200,0.3); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #00e5ff; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00e5ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: LED Indicator (Status Dot)
components.description: Small colored circle (8px) with blink animation. Three color variants: green (active/online), amber (warning/in-progress), red (error/reset). Paired with a mono UPPERCASE label.
components.css: .ds-led-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-led-status__dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-led-status__dot--green { background: #00ff41; animation: ds-led-blink 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-led-status__dot--amber { background: #ffaa00; } .ds-led-status__dot--red { background: #ff3344; } .ds-led-status__label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.5rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #8a9088; text-transform: uppercase; } @keyframes ds-led-blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } }

components.name: Social Icon Button (Pad Contact)
components.description: Small square icon button for social links (GitHub, LinkedIn). Silver via-ring border at rest, shifts to gold pad on hover with pad-hover shadow. 40x40px, square with slight rounding.
components.css: .ds-btn-social { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; background: #0e120e; border: 1px solid rgba(106,114,128,0.3); border-radius: 0.125rem; color: #8a9088; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-social:hover { border-color: #d4a843; color: #d4a843; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(212,168,67,0.3), 0 2px 0 rgba(180,140,60,0.6); } .ds-btn-social:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c4a44a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-social__icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.name: Component Label (Designator Badge)
components.description: Section-level PCB designator label — mono, uppercase, tight tracking. Rendered in trace cyan or copper gold above section headings. Identifies the PCB component type (U1, IC1, J1, etc.).
components.css: .ds-comp-label { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #8a9088; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-comp-label--trace { color: #00c8c8; } .ds-comp-label--copper { color: #c4a44a; }

components.name: Header Bar (Fixed Navigation)
components.description: Fixed top navigation bar — substrate background with backdrop blur, subtle trace bottom border with a bright trace edge highlight line. Contains U1 processor pad with green LED, mono nav links, and dark mode toggle.

components.css: .ds-header { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 50; background: rgba(8,12,8,0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,200,200,0.10); } .ds-header::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0,200,200,0.3) 50%, transparent 100%); } .ds-header__inner { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-header__brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-header__u1 { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; background: #080c08; border: 1px solid rgba(196,164,74,0.5); border-radius: 0.125rem; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-header__brand:hover .ds-header__u1 { border-color: #c4a44a; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(212,168,67,0.3), 0 2px 0 rgba(180,140,60,0.6); } .ds-header__u1-text { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #c4a44a; letter-spacing: -0.05em; } .ds-header__u1-led { position: absolute; top: -2px; right: -2px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #00ff41; animation: ds-led-blink 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-header__brand-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: #8a9088; } .ds-header__nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; } @keyframes ds-led-blink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.3; } } @media (max-width: 1024px) { .ds-header__nav { display: none; } }

narrative.northStar: The Portfolio as PCB Circuit Board
narrative.overview:
The portfolio page is a printed circuit board viewed from above — an FR-4 dark substrate with copper traces, gold contact pads, silver vias, and white silkscreen labeling. The visitor is a technician examining the board: U1 is the central processor (the developer), traces route to peripheral modules (skills, projects), and contact pads provide connection points. The aesthetic is technical, angular, and unapologetically electronic — no soft UI, no pill shapes, no gradients. Colors are solid; geometry belongs to the board.

Every section carries a PCB component designator (U1, M1–M8, IC1–IC4, J1, J3). Interactive elements use trace cyan (signals flowing) or copper gold (contact pads). Status is communicated through LED indicators (green active, amber warning, red error). The language of the board extends to labels: click targets use snake_case or UPPERCASE mono text that reads like silkscreen annotations rather than traditional UI buttons.

Motion is minimal and purposeful — LED blinks suggest the board is live, signal pulses invite scrolling along the trace path, and section alternation between substrate and ground plane creates a visual rhythm that maps to the board's layered construction.
keyCharacteristics: FR-4 dark substrate (#080c08) with green undertone as base, alternating with deeper ground plane (#060a06) for section rhythm
Copper trace cyan (#00c8c8 → #00e5ff) for active signals, interactive elements, primary CTAs
Gold contact pads (#c4a44a → #d4a843) for contact points, links, secondary actions, social icons
Silver via rings (#a0a8b0 → #c8d0d8) for structural borders, passive elements, non-interactive chrome
White silkscreen text (#d8dcd6) for body copy with dim variant (#8a9088) for secondary text and labels
PCB component designators on every section: U1, EXP1–EXP2, M1–M8, IC1–IC4, EDU1, CERT1–CERT6, J1, J3, P1–P5, MSG, BUS01–BUS06, GND, VCC, TX, RX, RST
Dual-type system: Exo 2 for display/body, JetBrains Mono for labels/designators/code/pins — mono never used for running body text
Angular geometry: 0.125rem pad radius, 0.25rem component radius, 0.5rem chip radius maximum — no pill shapes, no large-radius cards
Shadow-based elevation: components lifted off substrate with deep shadows and 1px trace-colored ring edges
LED status indicators (green/amber/red) with blink animation marking live system state

rules.name: The Dark-Only Rule
rules.body: The PCB world is inherently dark. A light mode toggle exists but the palette is not designed for it. Lock dark mode or fully design the light variant — the substrate, traces, and pads have no light-mode equivalents.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Colors are solid — the PCB aesthetic rejects gradients. The sole exception is a subtle radial gradient in the hero background, which represents ambient light on the board surface, not decoration. No other gradients anywhere.

rules.name: The Mono-Silkscreen Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved exclusively for labels, designators, terminal output, pin counts, code, and technical annotations — never for running body text. Body text always uses Exo 2. If it reads like a paragraph, it's not mono.

rules.name: The Angular Geometry Rule
rules.body: No border-radius above 0.5rem. Components are angular — the geometry belongs to the board, not to soft UI. Pads at 0.125rem, components at 0.25rem, chip outlines at 0.5rem maximum. No pill shapes, no large-radius cards, no circles for content containers.

rules.name: The Lucide-Only Rule
rules.body: All icons come from Lucide with consistent 1.5px stroke weight. No mixed icon libraries, no emoji, no unicode glyphs as icons. The icon set is treated as silkscreen symbols printed on the board.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state — hover triggers deeper elevation with trace-colored ring intensification and ambient glow. No static decorative shadows; their presence signals interactivity.

rules.name: The Section Alternation Rule
rules.body: Sections alternate between bg-substrate (inner routing layers) and bg-plane-ground (ground plane sections). Desktop shows a vertical trace-line at left-8 in every substrate section. This rhythm maps to the alternating copper and ground layers of a multi-layer PCB.

rules.name: The Interactive Naming Rule
rules.body: Click targets use naming conventions from electronics documentation: primary actions in snake_case (ver_proyectos), secondary actions in lowercase (contactar), form submits in UPPERCASE (TRANSMITIR, ENVIAR), status in UPPERCACE (STATUS: ACTIVE, PROCESSING...). These are not buttons — they are silkscreen annotations on active circuit traces.

dos: Do use trace cyan (#00c8c8, #00e5ff) for primary interactive elements — buttons, links, focus rings, active signals
Do use gold copper (#c4a44a, #d4a843) for secondary actions, contact pads, and section accents that differentiate from trace paths
Do use silver via rings (#a0a8b0, #c8d0d8) exclusively for structural borders, dividers, and non-interactive chrome
Do pair every section heading with a component-label designator (component-label class) in trace or copper
Do use rounded-pad (0.125rem) for buttons and small interactive elements — they are contact pads on the board
Do use rounded-component (0.25rem) with shadow-component for chip bodies (cards, panels) — they are ICs mounted on the board
Do use chip-body class as the universal container for skills modules, project cards, about chips, and education panels
Do alternate section backgrounds between bg-substrate and bg-plane-ground to create the layered PCB rhythm
Do use JetBrains Mono at 0.5rem–0.75rem with 0.08em–0.2em tracking for all labels, designators, pin counts, and technical annotations
Do use Exo 2 for all body text — display at 800 weight for the hero name, headings at 700, body at 300–400
Do place a green LED indicator (led-green, animate-led-blink) on U1 processor elements to signal the system is live
Do use Lucide icons exclusively at 1.5px stroke weight — they are silkscreen symbols on the board
donts: Don't use gradients anywhere except the sole hero radial ambient light — the board is solid material
Don't use border-radius above 0.5rem — no pill shapes, no large-radius cards, no circular content containers
Don't use JetBrains Mono for running body text — mono is for labels, designators, code, and terminal output only
Don't mix icon libraries — Lucide only, no emoji, no unicode glyphs as icons
Don't use zero-blur block shadows — all shadows carry offset plus soft blur to simulate physical board depth
Don't use light mode with the current palette — the design system has no light-mode color equivalents; either lock dark mode or fully design the light variant
Don't use trace cyan (#00c8c8) and gold copper (#c4a44a) interchangeably — each has a distinct semantic role: trace for signals/actions, copper for contacts/secondary
